findings: 161 NPU requests succeed, including 13 warmups and 148 live desktop draws. All successful responses are acknowledged.

Two DWM draws fail with invalid texture-coordinate or indexable-temporary lookup. A complete 3346460-byte capture preserves a 1024 by 768 source-over draw with two textures, 30 vertices and a narrow scissor.
A later rejected pixel shader contains 200 words including x and y derivatives.
All three received frames are black; only the first arrives with the sole-display gate true. No Start action or visual input response is verified.
Both owned custom devices are removed successfully and the original desktop is visually restored. The stream controller removes its configuration.
The next CPU build starts during the tail of this trial; these observations are not performance comparisons.
